note: OLv2 leaderboard_bbh = 3-shot multiple-choice log-likelihood (acc_norm). SEA-LION (arXiv:2504.05747) Table 2 reports the same base model at BBH 34.1, attributing its English eval to 'the Open LLM Leaderboard (HuggingFace, 2024)' and listing the identical 6-benchmark OLv2 suite. OLv2's record carries model_sha/precision/date; SEA-LION's does not.
rerun_note: lm-eval 0.4.11 rerun of google/gemma-2-9b@beb0c08e on leaderboard_bbh reproduces OLv2's raw acc_norm to within 0.11pp (53.88 vs 53.77), confirming 34.10 (the leaderboard-normalized display) is a deterministic fingerprint of OLv2's pipeline.
